description: Label Validate. Validate printer commands. POST source (the raw commands) and language (tsc, zpl, epl, …). Credit cost: 1 credit per call.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

language.description: Language of the source commands. Example: tsc or zpl. Allowed values: tsc, zpl, epl, cpcl, dpl, sbpl, ipl. Default: "tsc".

source.description: Raw printer commands to validate. Also send language.

name: label_validate
title: Label Validate
